content.page_context: Reference list (entries 545-551) from a clinical guideline related to myocardial infarction with nonobstructive coronary arteries, Takotsubo syndrome, pericardial diseases, myocarditis, invasive coronary function testing (CorMicA), and ischaemia with non-obstructive coronary arteries (INOCA).
